description: This file defines an interface `LogNode` for a logging system, establishing a contract for logging nodes that can output log data and pass it along a chain.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that can output log data to specific targets and pass logs down the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct a LogNode to print log data with given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
